summary: Plugin and module docs stay embedded as Python docstrings and are viewed with ansible-doc using the FQCN; the Galaxy namespace comes from galaxy.yml and may differ from the GitHub org.
questions: How do I view the docs for a lookup plugin in a collection?
Why does ansible-doc not find my plugin by short name?
Does my Galaxy namespace have to match my GitHub org name?

answer_card.title: View plugin docs in a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
Keep plugin/module docs as embedded docstrings and view them with the FQCN:
```bash
ansible-doc -t lookup my_namespace.my_collection.lookup1
```
The namespace is set in `galaxy.yml` and can differ from your GitHub org or repo name.
